doc.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996

title: RCA man signing Elvis
summary: He recalls recording at RCA Victor the week an RCA man signed an artist for a lot of money; he cannot recall the name.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Black music. As a matter of fact I was recording with RCA Victor that week that, I’m trying to think of his name, went down, the sign presser— © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
Yeah I can’t recall his name either.

Anyway, he came back, we was in the studio. And he said, “Man I just signed — God I know they’re going to fire me, because we gave him so much money,” and that’s who it was. I’m trying to think of his name. RCA Victor has still got those tapes that I did with —
It wasn’t his manager you’re talking about.
Well, I guess he didn’t get fired.
